title: FDA Medication Guide distribution
rule_summary: When FDA requires a Medication Guide for a product, the authorized dispenser must provide it under the conditions in 21 CFR Part 208, subject to the regulation's exceptions.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply medication guides requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing medication guides with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
